title: Good things, kept together.
description: A little library of tools, ideas, and things worth coming back to.

items.title: Orbit Studio
items.description: A calmer space to shape your next idea.
items.details: An imagined creative workspace for collecting references, arranging ideas, and finding a little more focus. This example shows how a useful tool can sit alongside the projects and writing it inspires.

items.title: Quiet Spaces
items.description: An exploration of light, space, and slower living.
items.details: A fictional architectural study of sunlit courtyards, simple materials, and places with room to breathe. A project card can tell the story behind a body of work, with context that goes beyond its cover.

items.title: The Art of Noticing
items.description: Small observations. A different way of seeing.
items.details: An illustrative reading entry about making room for everyday curiosity. Use this space for a short review, a favorite idea in your own words, or a note about why an article belongs in your collection.

image.alt: A lavender book with botanical shadows

items.title: Color Field Notes
items.description: Colors, textures, and moments from the everyday.
items.details: A sample reference library for palettes discovered in ordinary places: folded paper, weathered walls, and changing light. Bookmarks can have the same rich context as every other kind of collection item.

items.title: Frame by Frame
items.description: Thoughtful tools for creative work, one frame at a time.
items.details: An imagined toolkit for exploring sequences, rhythm, and visual storytelling. This is demonstration content, with no account, subscription, or external service behind it.

image.alt: Blue geometric blocks and a sphere

items.title: A Growing Archive
items.description: Notes, plants, and small experiments in a calmer life.
items.details: A fictional botanical journal that follows leaves, growth, and the changing seasons. Use project cards for work in progress as well as finished pieces.

image.alt: Green leaves against a pale wall

items.title: Gentle Systems
items.description: A few good habits for a more considered creative practice.
items.details: A sample essay entry about building a practice that leaves room for exploration. Keep a concise summary in the card and longer context in the detail view.

items.title: Material Library
items.description: A tactile collection of surfaces and simple materials.
items.details: An illustrative resource for paper, stone, cloth, and clay. Collection categories describe what an item is; tags connect themes across different kinds of items.

items.title: Margin Notes
items.description: A small place for ideas that arrive between other things.
items.details: A fictional note-taking tool for capturing fragments before they disappear. This example can be replaced with a real resource by adding an optional HTTP or HTTPS URL to its data.

image.alt: A lavender book with botanical shadows

items.title: Paper Perspectives
items.description: Finding unexpected form in an ordinary sheet of paper.
items.details: A sample series of folded-paper studies. Strong cover imagery gives a collection its character while the framework stays useful across different subjects.

items.title: On Making Time
items.description: A thoughtful pause for the work that matters.
items.details: An illustrative reading note on attention, creative routines, and unhurried work. All entries in this starter collection are original demonstration copy.

image.alt: Blue geometric blocks and a sphere

items.title: Everyday Nature
items.description: A field guide to looking a little closer.
items.details: A sample bookmark for nature-inspired observations and reference material. Replace this entry with your own public resource, image, and description when building a collection.
